model_system: dipole-octupole Kramers doublets on a 2D triangular lattice with nearest-neighbor anisotropic pseudospin exchange

key_params.Hamiltonian: H = sum_<rr'>(Jx T_r^x T_r'^x + Jy T_r^y T_r'^y + Jz T_r^z T_r'^z) - h sum_r (cos(theta) T_r^z + sin(theta) T_r^y)
key_params.original_model: H0 = sum_<rr'>(Jx tau_r^x tau_r'^x + Jy tau_r^y tau_r'^y + Jz tau_r^z tau_r'^z + Jyz(tau_r^y tau_r'^z + tau_r^z tau_r'^y))
key_params.octupolar_wave_dispersion: omega_k = sqrt([Jy sum_i cos(k·a_i) - 3Jx][Jz sum_i cos(k·a_i) - 3Jx])

headline_claim: For the ferro-octupolar state at (Jx,Jy,Jz)=(-1,-0.2,-0.5) and theta=pi/3, the mean-field transition occurs at To = 1.5|Jx|, with no divergent magnetic susceptibility despite time-reversal breaking octupolar order.
replication_difficulty: medium - analytic/mean-field model with straightforward lattice sums, but the paper head omits some rotated-coupling definitions in the Supplementary Information.
